subject: Change stacking behaviour in ggplot2 2.2.0 geom_bar not suitable with coord_flip()

messages.author: 7cd83d976d262e63
messages.subject: Change stacking behaviour in ggplot2 2.2.0 geom_bar not suitable with coord_flip()
parts:
The stacking behaviour of geom_bar has been reversed such that the order of items is the same as in the legend. This seems not to be suitable when bars are horizontal orientated (apply coord_flip()).


library(ggplot2)

x <- data.frame(
  a=c("A", "B", "A", "B"),
  b=c("x", "x", "y", "y"),
  m=c(4, 8, 7, 3)
)

ggplot(x, aes(x=a, y = m)) + geom_col(aes(x = a, y = m, fill = b)) + coord_flip()


Moreover, if the legend direction is horizontal too, we are back to the old confusing dis-alignment of items in the bar and the legend:


library(ggplot2)

x <- data.frame(
  a=c("A", "B", "A", "B"),
  b=c("x", "x", "y", "y"),
  m=c(4, 8, 7, 3)
)

ggplot(x, aes(x=a, y = m)) + geom_col(aes(x = a, y = m, fill = b)) + coord_flip() + theme(legend.position="bottom",  legend.direction = "horizontal")


To reverse the order of factors seems not to be a solution in this case.


Is there any other solution?

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Change stacking behaviour in ggplot2 2.2.0 geom_bar not suitable with coord_flip()
parts:
You can do position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)

Hadley
